PDF submission is permitted subject to the prescribed format and footnote 3 e-Cert requirement. Treating the extracted permission as unconditional would omit a source qualification; this does not make its absence from a resubmission-trigger formula a defect.

The date-only candidate node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes filings before 9:00am on 2 February 2026. The source also states a 9:00am launch and a blackout ending then. Retain the date-effective and operational-launch interpretations without treating the date-only predicate as equivalent to the launch-instant predicates.

The supplied source does not explicitly establish the governing timezone. Instant-based candidates require an authoritative timezone basis, with no identifiable supplied dependency mapping. The exact inclusion of the launch instant also interprets 'following its implementation'.

The trigger formulas do not decide whether a STREAMS 2 filing complies with format, schema or certificate requirements. A false trigger must not be read as permission to submit through another channel or as confirmation of filing compliance.
A later compliant resubmission does not erase the historical triggering event. The history candidate answers whether a trigger ever existed, not whether a duty remains outstanding.
The history candidate delegates event quantification and negative-history completeness to an external factual aggregate. Its formula does not itself verify those properties.
The four null-hash dependency IDs have no supplied descriptions linking them to particular authorities. No catalogue mapping or availability can be inferred from their identifiers.
